$schema-comment: Per-example policy for the example E2E shard script. mode=verify waits for a settled frame and compares it to e2e/goldens/<example>.png; mode=smoke only requires the app to start and show non-blank content; mode=skip does not run the example at all. env is forwarded to the app as waterui.env.* intent extras (the generated MainActivity applies them via Os.setenv before the native library loads).

chromium.reason: CEF has no Android realization; the example cannot function on an emulator

webview-cef.reason: CEF has no Android realization; the example cannot function on an emulator

animation.reason: continuous animation never reaches a settled frame

audio_visualizer.reason: continuous animation driven by audio input

chart.reason: GPU-rendered surface; software-renderer antialiasing is not golden-stable

filter.reason: GPU-rendered filter effects; the repository boundary contract requires visual verification and forbids pixel-exact golden comparison

gallery.reason: loads remote images over the network

gradient.reason: animated mesh gradient never reaches a settled frame

image.reason: remote images arrive asynchronously over the network

map.reason: SwiftShader kills the wgpu device roughly every 35s; water-rs/waterui#914 rebuilds the runtime on loss, so this verifies survival, not pixels. Tile fetch plus a loss-recovery cycle needs well over the default window

multi_window.reason: secondary windows need windowing the single-display emulator lacks

reminders.reason: may raise a runtime permission prompt over the content

reply.reason: avatars and message photos load over the network from a remote repository, so a settled frame may or may not contain them

stress.reason: stress drivers mutate state on timers; counts scaled to emulator capacity (android-backend#86)

video_player.reason: video playback never reaches a settled frame

waterkit_camera_filters.reason: camera preview stream never reaches a settled frame

webview.reason: remote page loads asynchronously over the network
